description: Pay for one call to an Autonomo API with x402 and return the answer. Spends USDG or $AUTONOMO from the configured wallet on Robinhood Chain (usually 0.01 USDG or 100 $AUTONOMO), within a per-call cap and a daily budget. Returns the data and the payment transaction link.

path.description: The path from find_apis with the <…> parts filled in, e.g. /risk/0xabc…

slug.description: The API's slug from find_apis, e.g. token-risk.

name: call_api
title: Pay for and call an API
